source_message:
feat(review): G-15 Multi-Agent Review Pattern — Plan>Build>Review, 28 tests

- review/review_agent.py: ReviewAgent independent rule-based reviewer;
  ReviewRequest (proposed_change, change_class, author_agent_id, target_file,
  rationale, author_level), ReviewResult (approved, reviewer_agent_id, concerns,
  risk_score, recommendation, resolved_class)
- Decision logic: CLASS_B→REJECT(100), CLASS_C→ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN(75),
  CLASS_D→REJECT(100), CLASS_A→rule-based (I-21 +90, I-22 +85, trust-zone +70,
  BC-boundary +20/25, no-rationale +10); risk>80→REJECT, risk>50→ESCALATE
- Auto-detects change class from target_file path/name (SOUL.md→B, *.rego→C, ADR-→D)
- All decisions logged via StructuredLogger.event() (I-24 audit append-only)
- review/__init__.py: package exports
- Integration: feedback_loop.py calls ReviewAgent.review(request) before apply

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
